notes: בָּרִאשֹׁנָה was split into an `unrepresented` preposition, an `unrepresented` assimilated article and an adjective holding the phrase's one English word. Rule 30's one-English-word condition is met here and its own text directs the fusion in preference to one rendered morpheme beside others marked `unrepresented`; the corpus aligns the same phrase at ISA.60.9 as a single Rd+Td+Aafsa unit to *first*. Every other multi-morpheme, single-word rendering in this chapter is fused, so the split was also the chapter's one outlier of its kind. Nothing else in the verse changes.
